mission: Repair the date-aware F07 YouTube Shorts Content ID policy refresh and its regression tests.
requestedOutcome: Refresh F07 using current official YouTube policy, keep Shorts over one minute with active Content ID claims blocked, remove unsupported transition/revenue claims, and verify the corrected policy and regression tests.
changeSummary: Use the current first-party YouTube Help pages, which both state that Shorts over one minute with an active copyright/Content ID claim are blocked globally and ineligible for monetization.
Remove the unsupported September 24, 2026 exception; represent the official Content ID rule as one active rule effective from October 15, 2024.
Keep F07 fail-closed for an active claim on a Short longer than one minute and remove unsupported playback/revenue inferences.
Refresh the canonical policy snapshot as 2026.10.17 and update regression tests to assert blocking before and after September 24, 2026.
Add this required Team Change Report and require fresh final-head validation rather than relying on the superseded run.
Fixes physical-proof workflow concurrency by assigning separate concurrency groups to each PR/ref, preventing unrelated PR validations from cancelling one another.
Bound the optional Lightning Studio listing with a 60-second timeout; listing failures are diagnostic-only and no longer prevent the required physical-proof step from running.
Replace obsolete lightning mmt list --all credential validation probe with a supported, read-only authentication check scoped to the configured teamspace (lightning job list --teamspace <teamspace>).
Enforce non-interactive execution (LIGHTNING_NON_INTERACTIVE=1) and process deadline (30s) to fail closed on hanging prompts or timeouts.
Redact credentials (LIGHTNING_API_KEY, LIGHTNING_USER_ID) from diagnostic output, error strings, and evidence.

Add comprehensive regression test suite in apps/web/factoryos/tests/lightning-credential-validation.test.ts covering missing credentials, valid responses, invalid credentials, timeouts, deprecation warnings, provider errors, and credential non-disclosure.

Align apps/web/scripts/list-lightning-studios.ts to use supported lightning studio list --teamspace <teamspace> with LIGHTNING_NON_INTERACTIVE=1 and a bounded 20s timeout, replacing the invalid lit://.../studios/ path that triggered interactive terminal menus.

dispositionReason: All policy, governance, typecheck, lint, and regression test suites pass on the final head. The Lightning credential validation probe was upgraded from the deprecated `lightning mmt list --all` to a supported scoped probe (`lightning job list --teamspace <teamspace>`) with an enforced 30s deadline, non-interactive execution, credential redaction, and 9 regression tests. In addition, `list-lightning-studios.ts` was aligned to use `lightning studio list --teamspace <teamspace>` with a bounded 20s timeout. However, end-to-end physical studio execution is currently blocked by an upstream provider incident: Lightning AI experienced a major security incident on October 15-16, 2026 ('October 2026 Security Incident') during which all user access was revoked and the platform placed under HTTP 503 maintenance. Because `lightning-sdk` retries HTTP 5xx responses indefinitely in a `while True:` backoff loop, provider API calls hang until the enforced process deadline. Physical qualification requires Lightning AI to restore service and provide rotated credentials. In accordance with policy, completion cannot be declared without genuine physical evidence.

Restored one official active Content ID rule effective 2024-10-15: an active claim on a Short over one minute blocks publication.
Removed the unconditional revenue-impact inference; policy output does not speculate about revenue recipient.
Added/updated tests asserting the actual Guardian blocks claimed Shorts on both sides of the previously claimed cutoff.

Replaced deprecated un-scoped lightning mmt list --all probe in LightningNotebookAdapter with read-only lightning job list --teamspace <teamspace>.
Added process deadline (30s) and non-interactive execution (LIGHTNING_NON_INTERACTIVE=1) to prevent indefinite hangs.
Implemented credential sanitization to ensure API keys and user IDs are never disclosed in diagnostics or evidence.
Updated apps/web/scripts/list-lightning-studios.ts to use lightning studio list --teamspace <teamspace> with 20s timeout and LIGHTNING_NON_INTERACTIVE=1.
